title: Residual bypass for PNN-v1-alpha1
research_question: Can a small residual linear bypass improve PNN-v1 task accuracy and stability while preserving the compact Q.ANT-native Fourier/KAN hierarchy?

evidence_from_exp002.interpretation: The preregistered normalization intervention produced only a small stability reduction and slightly lower mean accuracy; reference/Q.ANT disagreement remained low.

hypothesis: Alpha1 is constrained more by representation/task fit than by Q.ANT numerical mismatch. Adding a low-parameter linear residual path from the 48-dimensional hierarchical representation to the two logits can improve classification without replacing the Q.ANT Fourier/KAN nonlinear path.
frozen_candidates: alpha2 residual-head: Fourier/KAN 48->2 logits plus trainable linear 48->2 residual logits

data_protocol.selection_rule: Create one deterministic stratified validation split from canonical TRAIN only. Compare the two frozen candidates on validation across fixed seeds. Freeze the selected architecture before evaluating canonical TEST.
data_protocol.test_boundary: Do not use canonical TEST accuracy to select between alpha1 and alpha2.

design_constraints: Keep the 12 local 8->4 Fourier/KAN blocks unchanged.
Use raw ECG200 values so Exp003 changes architecture rather than preprocessing.
Change exactly one architectural dimension: the residual linear classifier path.
Report reference and Q.ANT evaluation separately.
primary_metric: Validation mean accuracy across fixed seeds, with validation standard deviation reported alongside it.
secondary_metrics: canonical TEST accuracy after candidate selection is frozen
success_criteria: Alpha2 must have higher mean validation accuracy than alpha1 and no worse validation accuracy standard deviation. Canonical TEST results are confirmatory and do not determine whether the preregistered architecture-selection criterion was met.
hardware_boundary: Software/simulation-backend experiment only; no real photonic hardware performance claim.
next_gate: Implement and review PNN-v1 Exp003, then add it to the guarded approval allowlist.
